svg.text: Requirement pathway — immutable revisions, approval timing, certificates and notifications
Selected physical columns / workspace source 2026-11-23. Not a live schema capture.
Physical FK map — parent → referencing child (composite owner keys summarized)
F1 pathway_requirement_snapshot → initial_pathway_request: owned input FK
F3 initial_pathway_revision → pathway_requirement_step: same owned revision FK
F4 pathway_requirement_step → pathway_requirement_option: same request revision step
F5 pathway_requirement_step → pathway_requirement_dependency: prerequisite and dependent FKs
F6 pathway_requirement_step → pathway_requirement_bypass: authorized source decision
F7 certificate_submission → certificate_submission_attachment: one evidence form FK
F8 certificate_submission → certificate_submission_decision: same submission revision owner FK
F9 initial_pathway_request → initial_pathway_current: owned request FK
F10 initial_pathway_revision → initial_pathway_current: nullable current revision FK
F11 initial_pathway_revision → initial_pathway_approval: exact revision hash owner FKs
F12 initial_pathway_revision → initial_pathway_revision: nullable approval_basis_revision FK
First approval freezes UTC duration/basis/start/deadline; completion/on-time freeze when resolved. Older approvals stay untimed.
REJECTED retains target/proposal/history. State/time does not award achievement or bypass missing learning conditions.
assessedSources stays in revision Plan JSON; dependency.assessed_source is the physical failed-assessment provenance column.
Certificate request/step references and notification deep links are JSON/text, not invented SQL or cross-store FKs.
Notification dedup/observation is separate from read state and SMTP delivery. Refresh/outcome jobs retain the existing processing owner.
V79 — Certificate definition authoring (separate from Employee evidence)

g.text: Authoring states: DRAFT / SUBMITTED / REJECTED / PUBLISHING / PUBLISH_FAILED / PUBLISHED.
Batch ids JSON stores retry receipts; it does not create a physical FK to draft rows.
View acknowledgement is exact draft + revision + reviewer; events retain immutable decision snapshots.
V80-V82: explicit Employee, assigned-Expert and L&D review notification targets; staff requests stay in-app.
Certificate evidence approval reason is optional; rejection requires a reason (V82).
Definition publication applies to new pathways only; existing pathways keep their pinned definition.
